notes.title: Update_22_02_16_EA_Version0.1.0.D
notes.content:
Update_22_02_16_EA_Version0.1.0.D
FireTrap_Development

Update the list.

- Add a flame trap.
After this patch, very powerful flame traps hidden throughout the dungeons are waiting for you.
This trap takes away your physical strength and data in large quantities. It is difficult to escape from the moment you are trapped to the end, so you can be attacked by the enemy.
Please be careful.

- Fixed and changed the normal attack coefficient.
It has been confirmed that the damage done to the enemy is too large compared to the attack power of the weapon. Accordingly, the damage dealt to the enemy has been modified to narrow the gap with the attack power.

- Weapons, torches, and element level-up systems are added.
We implemented a level-up system to create a variety of growth systems. The way to raise the level is simple. You just need to attack a lot! The weapon level must be attacked with a weapon, the torch level must be a torch attack, and the element level must be multiple element attacks.

- Add a dungeon clear achievement.
Now, if you clear the dungeon, you can break your achievements.

Thank you for buying this game.
We will continue to be a dungeon castle that develops.
